verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.pt: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses,

verses.en: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, My offering, and my bread for my sacrifices made by fire, for a sweet savour unto me, shall ye observe to offer unto me in their due season.
verses.pt: Manda aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Da minha oferta, do meu pão com os meus holocaustos em aroma agradável para mim, tereis cuidado de as oferecer a mim no tempo devido.
verses.en_web: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘See that you present my offering, my food for my offerings made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to me, in their due season.’
verses.en_bbe: Give orders to the children of Israel and say to them, Let it be your care to give me my offerings at their regular times, the food of the offerings made by fire to me for a sweet smell.

verses.en: And thou shalt say unto them, This is the offering made by fire which ye shall offer unto the LORD; two lambs of the first year without spot day by day, for a continual burnt offering.
verses.pt: E lhes dirás: Esta é a oferta queimada que apresentareis ao SENHOR: dois cordeiros sem mácula de ano, cada dia, será o holocausto contínuo.
verses.en_web: You shall tell them, ‘This is the offering made by fire which you shall offer to Yahweh: male lambs a year old without defect, two day by day, for a continual burnt offering.
verses.en_bbe: Say to them, This is the offering made by fire which you are to give to the Lord; he-lambs of the first year without any mark, two every day as a regular burned offering.

verses.en: The one lamb shalt thou offer in the morning, and the other lamb shalt thou offer at even;
verses.pt: Um cordeiro oferecerás pela manhã, e o outro cordeiro oferecerás entre as duas tardes:
verses.en_web: You shall offer the one lamb in the morning, and you shall offer the other lamb at evening;
verses.en_bbe: Let one be offered in the morning, and the other at evening;

verses.en: And a tenth part of an ephah of flour for a meat offering, mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil.
verses.pt: E a décima de um efa de boa farinha, amassada com uma quarta parte de um him de azeite prensado, em oferta de cereais.
verses.en_web: with one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil.
verses.en_bbe: And the tenth part of an ephah of the best meal for a meal offering mixed with the fourth part of a hin of clear oil.

verses.en: It is a continual burnt offering, which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.pt: É holocausto contínuo, que foi feito no monte Sinai em cheiro suave, oferta queimada ao SENHOR.
verses.en_web: It is a continual burnt offering, which was ordained in Mount Sinai for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: It is a regular burned offering, as it was ordered in Mount Sinai, for a sweet smell, an offering made by fire to the Lord.

verses.en: And the drink offering thereof shall be the fourth part of an hin for the one lamb: in the holy place shalt thou cause the strong wine to be poured unto the LORD for a drink offering.
verses.pt: E sua libação, a quarta parte de um him com cada cordeiro: derramarás libação de superior vinho ao SENHOR no santuário.
verses.en_web: Its drink offering shall be the fourth part of a hin for the one lamb. You shall pour out a drink offering of strong drink to Yahweh in the holy place.
verses.en_bbe: And for its drink offering take the fourth part of a hin for one lamb: in the holy place let the wine be drained out for a drink offering for the Lord.

verses.en: And the other lamb shalt thou offer at even: as the meat offering of the morning, and as the drink offering thereof, thou shalt offer it, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.pt: E oferecerás o segundo cordeiro entre as duas tardes: conforme a oferta da manhã, e conforme sua libação oferecerás, oferta queimada em cheiro suave ao SENHOR.
verses.en_web: The other lamb you shall offer at evening. As the meal offering of the morning, and as its drink offering, you shall offer it, an offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Let the other lamb be offered at evening; like the meal offering of the morning and its drink offering, let it be offered as an offering made by fire for a sweet smell to the Lord.

verses.en: And on the sabbath day two lambs of the first year without spot, and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, and the drink offering thereof:
verses.pt: Mas no dia do sábado dois cordeiros de ano sem defeito, e dois décimos de efa de flor de farinha amassada com azeite, por oferta de cereais, com sua libação:
verses.en_web: “‘On the Sabbath day, you shall offer two male lambs a year old without defect, and two tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with oil, and its drink offering:
verses.en_bbe: And on the Sabbath day, two he-lambs of the first year, without any mark, and two tenth parts of the best meal for a meal offering mixed with oil, and its drink offering:

verses.en: This is the burnt offering of every sabbath, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
verses.pt: É o holocausto do sábado em cada sábado, além do holocausto contínuo e sua libação.
verses.en_web: this is the burnt offering of every Sabbath, besides the continual burnt offering, and its drink offering.
verses.en_bbe: This is the burned offering for every Sabbath day, in addition to the regular burned offering, and its drink offering.

verses.en: And in the beginnings of your months ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the LORD; two young bullocks, and one ram, seven lambs of the first year without spot;
verses.pt: E nos princípios de vossos meses oferecereis em holocausto ao SENHOR dois bezerros das vacas, e um carneiro, e sete cordeiros de ano sem defeito;
verses.en_web: “‘In the beginnings of your months, you shall offer a burnt offering to Yahweh: two young bulls, and one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect;
verses.en_bbe: And on the first day of every month you are to give a burned offering to the Lord; two oxen, one male sheep, and seven he-lambs of the first year, without any mark;

verses.en: And three tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one bullock; and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one ram;
verses.pt: E três décimos de efa de boa farinha amassada com azeite, por oferta de cereais com cada bezerro; e dois décimos de efa de boa farinha amassada com azeite, por oferta de cereais com cada carneiro;
verses.en_web: and three tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with oil, for each bull; and two tenth parts of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with oil, for the one ram;
verses.en_bbe: And three tenth parts of the best meal for a meal offering mixed with oil, for every ox; and two tenth parts of the best meal for a meal offering mixed with oil, for the one sheep;

verses.en: And a several tenth deal of flour mingled with oil for a meat offering unto one lamb; for a burnt offering of a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.pt: E um décimo de efa de boa farinha amassada com azeite, em oferta de cereais com cada cordeiro; holocausto de aroma suave, oferta queimada ao SENHOR.
verses.en_web: and one tenth part of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering to every lamb; for a burnt offering of a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And a separate tenth part of the best meal mixed with oil for a meal offering for every lamb; for a burned offering of a sweet smell, an offering made by fire to the Lord.

verses.en: And their drink offerings shall be half an hin of wine unto a bullock, and the third part of an hin unto a ram, and a fourth part of an hin unto a lamb: this is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.
verses.pt: E suas libações de vinho, meio him com cada bezerro, e o terço de um him com cada carneiro, e a quarta parte de um him com cada cordeiro. Este é o holocausto de cada mês por todos os meses do ano.
verses.en_web: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bull, and the third part of a hin for the ram, and the fourth part of a hin for a lamb. This is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.
verses.en_bbe: And their drink offerings are to be half a hin of wine for an ox, and the third part of a hin for a male sheep, and the fourth part of a hin for a lamb: this is the burned offering for every month through all the months of the year.

verses.en: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering unto the LORD shall be offered, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
verses.pt: E um bode macho em expiação se oferecerá ao SENHOR, além do holocausto contínuo com sua libação.
verses.en_web: One male goat for a sin offering to Yahweh; it shall be offered besides the continual burnt offering, and its drink offering.
verses.en_bbe: And one he-goat for a sin-offering to the Lord; it is to be offered in addition to the regular burned offering and its drink offering.

verses.en: And in the fourteenth day of the first month is the passover of the LORD.
verses.pt: Mas no mês primeiro, aos catorze do mês será a páscoa do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: “‘In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is Yahweh’s Passover.
verses.en_bbe: And in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is the Lord's Passover.

verses.en: And in the fifteenth day of this month is the feast: seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.
verses.pt: E aos quinze dias deste mês, a solenidade: por sete dias se comerão pães ázimos.
verses.en_web: On the fifteenth day of this month shall be a feast. Unleavened bread shall be eaten for seven days.
verses.en_bbe: On the fifteenth day of this month there is to be a feast; for seven days let your food be unleavened cakes.

verses.en: In the first day shall be an holy convocation; ye shall do no manner of servile work therein:
verses.pt: No primeiro dia, santa convocação; nenhuma obra servil fareis:
verses.en_web: In the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work;
verses.en_bbe: On the first day there is to be a holy meeting: you may do no sort of field-work:

verses.en: But ye shall offer a sacrifice made by fire for a burnt offering unto the LORD; two young bullocks, and one ram, and seven lambs of the first year: they shall be unto you without blemish:
verses.pt: E oferecereis por oferta queimada em holocausto ao SENHOR dois bezerros das vacas, e um carneiro, e sete cordeiros de um ano; sem defeito os tomareis;
verses.en_web: but you shall offer an offering made by fire, a burnt offering to Yahweh: two young bulls, and one ram, and seven male lambs a year old; they shall be to you without defect;
verses.en_bbe: And you are to give an offering made by fire, a burned offering to the Lord; two oxen, one male sheep, and seven he-lambs of the first year, without any mark:

verses.en: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil: three tenth deals shall ye offer for a bullock, and two tenth deals for a ram;
verses.pt: E sua oferta de cereais de farinha amassada com azeite: três décimos de efa com cada bezerro, e dois décimos com cada carneiro oferecereis;
verses.en_web: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil. You shall offer three tenths for a bull, and two tenths for the ram.
verses.en_bbe: And their meal offering, the best meal mixed with oil: let three tenth parts of an ephah be offered for an ox and two tenth parts for a male sheep;

verses.en: A several tenth deal shalt thou offer for every lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
verses.pt: Com cada um dos sete cordeiros oferecereis um décimo;
verses.en_web: You shall offer one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;
verses.en_bbe: And a separate tenth part for every one of the seven lambs;

verses.en: And one goat for a sin offering, to make an atonement for you.
verses.pt: e um bode macho por expiação, para vos reconciliar.
verses.en_web: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you.
verses.en_bbe: And one he-goat for a sin-offering to take away your sin.

verses.en: Ye shall offer these beside the burnt offering in the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.
verses.pt: Isto oferecereis além do holocausto da manhã, que é o holocausto contínuo.
verses.en_web: You shall offer these besides the burnt offering of the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.
verses.en_bbe: These are to be offered in addition to the morning burned offering, which is a regular burned offering at all times.

verses.en: After this manner ye shall offer daily, throughout the seven days, the meat of the sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD: it shall be offered beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
verses.pt: Conforme isto oferecereis cada um dos sete dias, alimento e oferta queimada em cheiro suave ao SENHOR; será oferecido além do holocausto contínuo, com sua libação.
verses.en_web: In this way you shall offer daily, for seven days, the food of the offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh. It shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering, and its drink offering.
verses.en_bbe: In this way, every day for seven days, give the food of the offering made by fire, a sweet smell to the Lord: it is to be offered in addition to the regular burned offering, and its drink offering.

verses.en: And on the seventh day ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work.
verses.pt: E no sétimo dia tereis santa convocação; nenhuma obra servil fareis.
verses.en_web: On the seventh day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.
verses.en_bbe: Then on the seventh day there will be a holy meeting; you may do no field-work.

verses.en: Also in the day of the firstfruits, when ye bring a new meat offering unto the LORD, after your weeks be out, ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work:
verses.pt: Também no dia das primícias, quando oferecerdes oferta de cereais novos ao SENHOR em vossas semanas, tereis santa convocação; nenhuma obra servil fareis;
verses.en_web: “‘Also in the day of the first fruits, when you offer a new meal offering to Yahweh in your feast of weeks, you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work;
verses.en_bbe: And at the time of the first-fruits, when you give an offering of new meal to the Lord at your feast of weeks, there is to be a holy meeting: you may do no field-work:

verses.en: But ye shall offer the burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the LORD; two young bullocks, one ram, seven lambs of the first year;
verses.pt: E oferecereis em holocausto, em cheiro suave ao SENHOR, dois bezerros das vacas, um carneiro, sete cordeiros de um ano;
verses.en_web: but you shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old;
verses.en_bbe: And give a burned offering for a sweet smell to the Lord; two oxen, one male sheep, and seven he-lambs of the first year;

verses.en: And their meat offering of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals unto one bullock, two tenth deals unto one ram,
verses.pt: E a oferta de cereais deles, boa farinha amassada com azeite, três décimos de efa com cada bezerro, dois décimos com cada carneiro,
verses.en_web: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenths for each bull, two tenths for the one ram,
verses.en_bbe: And their meal offering, the best meal mixed with oil, three tenth parts for an ox, two tenth parts for a male sheep,

verses.en: A several tenth deal unto one lamb, throughout the seven lambs;
verses.pt: com cada um dos sete cordeiros uma décimo;
verses.en_web: one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;
verses.en_bbe: And a separate tenth part for every one of the seven lambs;

verses.en: And one kid of the goats, to make an atonement for you.
verses.pt: um bode macho, para fazer expiação por vós.
verses.en_web: one male goat, to make atonement for you.
verses.en_bbe: And one he-goat to take away your sin.

verses.en: Ye shall offer them beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, (they shall be unto you without blemish) and their drink offerings.
verses.pt: Vós os oferecereis, além do holocausto contínuo com suas ofertas de cereais, e suas libações; vós os apresentareis sem defeito.
verses.en_web: Besides the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, you shall offer them and their drink offerings. See that they are without defect.
verses.en_bbe: These are in addition to the regular burned offering and its meal offering; take care that they are without any mark, and let them be offered with their drink offerings.
